Full ledger fetch uses no-store, bounded payload and abort, request generations, immutable report reuse and original observation high-water marks.
New main-request abort bounds a hung fetch/body read. Independent earliest target/row/report expiry rerenders the table while a main request remains pending.

Timer generations prevent cancelled older callbacks clearing a later table. Visibility-resume and wall/monotonic anomaly paths clear stale availability without refreshing historical observation clocks.
